section_morphology_definitions.area: B=dx*sum(w_i), cross-sectional positive-relief area in m2, not accumulated sediment mass
section_morphology_definitions.datum: r_i=z_i-slope*(length-x); active channel cells excluded throughout; w_i=max(r_i,0) elsewhere
section_morphology_definitions.flanks: Lower/upper flank runs from first non-active cell to first crest cell / last crest cell to last non-active cell; each signed mean is r_i minus that flank's endpoint chord over observed non-active cells, including endpoints; no interpolation across channels
section_morphology_definitions.precision: Areas include conservative half-ULP float32 elevation-rounding bounds; widths, crest locations and flank descriptors are nominal, with grid resolution and channel gaps retained.
section_morphology_definitions.shape_scope: At least three non-active cells and positive crest required per flank. Positive departure means above the chord, negative below; this is not a local-curvature or published-concavity test.
section_morphology_definitions.widths: Equivalent width B/max(r_i); half-crest occupied width counts non-active cells r_i>=max(r_i)/2, span includes intervening gaps; undefined when max(r_i)<=0
